components.purpose: Opening section: the event title as the Heading, with a Register button as CTA 1, over a gradient background (backgroundType set to one of the gradient options such as yellow-pink).
Short free-text agenda below the hero. Rich Text Area accepts free-form text, so it fits an agenda written as prose.

Registration form at the bottom. This is the closest visible form component, but it is a contact form, not a registration form, so it may not offer the attendee fields a webinar needs. The Form Builder components (FormBuilder, AgilityFormBuilder) are marked not visible on this instance, and NewsletterSignup only collects a mailing-list signup, so neither fits better.
